subject.title: 🦞 Tracking: Ship & update the node with confidence

question: Which Windows packaging and update strategy should define completion for this epic?
rationale: Current main still combines Inno delivery with portable Updatum updates while the epic calls for MSIX identity, clean channel transitions, and Inno retirement, so the long-term supported package matrix requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Complete MSIX-first migration
options.body: Make signed MSIX/AppInstaller the supported install and update path, prove alpha-to-stable transitions, and retire or explicitly demote Inno and portable self-update.

options.title: Define an explicit hybrid
options.body: Keep multiple package forms but document, isolate, and test the identity and update semantics for every supported installed form.

recommendation.title: Complete MSIX-first migration
recommendation.body: Make signed MSIX/AppInstaller the supported install and update path, prove alpha-to-stable transitions, and retire or explicitly demote Inno and portable self-update.

likelyOwner.reason: This person coordinates the epic and authored its active packaging and compatibility children.
